claims: The historical survey distinguishes naive, advanced and modular retrieval-generation architectures.
Retrieval quality, context faithfulness, relevance and abstention are separate evaluation dimensions.
Its counterfactual robustness term denotes resistance to known inaccuracies in documents, not identification of causal counterfactuals.
Reported component/framework performance remains secondary; no new package/native/backend qualification follows.
limitations: March2024 historical survey, not2026frontier completeness or a causal inference proof.
Constituent benchmarks/packages require separate original technical sources.
Rendered charts/tables not newly inspected; inherited image allowance exhausted.

claims: CoT-SelfEvolve combines retrieved programming discussions and external execution/test feedback with iterative generation; self-correction does not mean feedback-free reasoning.
The study defines pass@n as sequential all-tests success within an attempt budget, not the independent finite-pool pass@k event.
Reported aggregate gains are protocol-specific and heterogeneous by library; larger attempt budgets increase reported prompt tokens.
Template publication metadata and anonymized artifact link prevent assuming a verified proceedings version or executable artifact availability.
Unit-test success does not establish a causal estimand, leakage-free retrieval, real bank correctness or economical accepted output.
limitations: Selected2024v1; FSE2025/footer and placeholder DOI are retained as unverified template metadata.
Figure/table aggregates differ across displayed settings; no raw runs, paired confidence intervals, full cost or decontamination audit was reproduced.
No live model or CoT-SelfEvolve artifact was executed; ANONYMIZED-LINK remains unresolved.
Metadata identifies first author as Quoc, Thai Tang while display order is Thai Tang Quoc; naming preserved transparently.

repairs_required_before_reuse: Separate retrieval relevance, evidential truth, causal applicability and downstream correctness.
Hold final causal-task tests out of adaptive repair feedback and audit retrieval/benchmark overlap.
Retain every attempt, failure, runtime and token cost; do not compare sequential pass@n with independent pass@k.
Resolve actual CoT-SelfEvolve code/data identity and version; do not substitute a similarly named repository.
